title: Fire and water
blurb: Water puts out lava. Lava puts out heroes.

title: Company
blurb: Goblins run at whoever they can reach. Get them wet first.

title: Heavy things
blurb: Boulders flatten whoever is in the way. Ideally goblins.

title: Demolition
blurb: Crates of powder open walls. Keep them dry. Stand back.

title: Strings attached
blurb: Same colour, same tap. Doors open for anything heavy.

title: Bad air
blurb: Gas goes up. Everything else still comes down.
